summary: You can look back a week, and heavy reports and Risk Analysis finish more reliably.

new.title: A week of history
new.text: Each installation keeps the findings of its newest 7 runs, so What changed and the history pages go back a week. When the database is 70% full, SecurityInsight keeps fewer runs and tells you.

fixes.title: Heavy attack-path reports complete
fixes.text: A report part that Microsoft keeps timing out on is now split into smaller parts, so the report completes instead of leaving parts unread.

fixes.title: The Summary view is always ready
fixes.text: The Summary view is built for every collection you can open, also when a preparation step failed the night before.

fixes.title: Risk Analysis ends much faster
fixes.text: The end of a large Risk Analysis is much faster, where it took hours at the largest installations. The results are the same.
